title: Commonsense on Demand: Generating and Selectively Integrating Commonsense Knowledge for Natural Language Inference
abstract: arXiv:2507.15100v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Natural Language Inference (NLI) determines whether a premise entails, contradicts, or is neutral with respect to a hypothesis. The task is often framed as emulating human inference, in which commonsense knowledge plays a major role. This study examines whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can reliably generate factual commonsense axioms for NLI, and evaluates their utility on the SNLI and ANLI benchmarks using Llama-3.1-70B and gpt-oss-120b. Because commonsense axioms lack explicit textual references, standard factuality metrics are ill-suited to their evaluation. We therefore introduce a reference-free method using an LLM-as-Judge framework. The evaluation reveals a substantial gap between models: gpt-oss-120b generates predominantly accurate axioms, whereas Llama produces more incorrect than correct ones. translated_title: 按需常识：生成并选择性整合常识知识用于自然语言推理
translated_abstract: 自然语言推理（NLI）判断前提是否蕴含、矛盾或与假设中立。该任务通常被构建为模拟人类推理，其中常识知识扮演重要角色。本研究探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）能否可靠地为NLI生成事实性的常识公理，并使用Llama-3.1-70B和gpt-oss-120b在SNLI和ANLI基准上评估其效用。由于常识公理缺乏明确的文本引用，标准的事实性度量方法不适用于其评估，因此我们引入了一种基于LLM作为裁判框架的无参考方法。评估揭示了模型间的显著差距：gpt-oss-120b生成的主要是准确的公理，而Llama生成的错误公理多于正确公理。我们进一步评估了三种提示流水线：直接推理、用生成的常识公理增强的推理，以及一种选择性整合方法。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种无参考的LLM-as-Judge评估方法，用于验证常识公理生成质量，并发现选择性整合常识知识能有效提升NLI推理性能，且gpt-oss-120b在生成准确常识方面显著优于Llama模型。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a reference-free LLM-as-Judge evaluation method for commonsense axiom generation, revealing that selectively integrating commonsense knowledge improves NLI performance, with gpt-oss-120b significantly outperforming Llama in generating accurate commonsense.
